topic: Study of pressure distribution over an aerofoil at various angles of attack, determination of center of pressure and aerodynamic center.
syllabus_extract: Study of pressure distribution over an aerofoil at various angles of attack, determination of center of pressure and aerodynamic center. various forces e.g. lift, drag and moments
specific_objectives: 11.1.2.1 Trainee will be able to describe various types of aerofoil sections, conditions of performance, theories, and concept related with performance

training_aids.remarks: Refer to the master syllabus reference list
Objective: teach the syllabus extract for this lesson

practical: Analysis of pressure distribution graphs for different angles of attack; identification of CP and AC locations; safety: No physical handling of live instruments; supervision: Instructor monitors graph interpretation.
intro_questions: What is the primary function of an aerofoil section?
Define the angle of attack in simple terms.
List the three main aerodynamic forces acting on a wing.

summary_questions: Explain why the center of pressure moves with angle of attack.
Why is the aerodynamic center preferred for stability calculations?
Describe how pressure distribution changes near the stall angle.
home_assignment_question: Prepare a brief note comparing the behavior of the center of pressure and aerodynamic center, referencing the concepts covered in LP 13 regarding vortex theory and lift generation.
